headline: Contract talks with the Educational Association of Worcester, a $450,000 Fair Share Earmarks Grant, and attendance and multilingual learner reports.
summary: A $450,000 state grant for wall repairs, playground improvements, and library access is up for approval. Two general business items ask administration for reports on student attendance and on how multilingual learners are identified for special education.
items: Executive session on contract negotiations with the Educational Association of Worcester, including several bargaining units
Executive session to review minutes of the November 12, 2026 meeting
Donation of $4,385 from District Attorney Joseph D Early Jr for Chandler Elementary School's Thanksgiving Feast
Donation of 500 coats from the WEDF for WPS Coats for Kids
Notification of new instructional and non-instructional hires, resignations, and retirements
Public comment, two minutes per speaker
Report on College Partnerships, recommended approve and file
Six prior year payments for paraeducator subseparate stipends, totaling $4,900
Prior year payment of $170.60 to a WPS employee
Fair Share Earmarks Grant from DESE, $450,000, for wall repairs, playground improvements, and library access partnership
Update on the WPS Homework Policy one year after implementation, recommended approve and file
Options for job and internship seekers through MassHire Worcester Career Center, recommended approve and file
Comprehensive student attendance report, referred to administration
Report on protocols between the Department of Multilingual Learners and the Department of Special Education to prevent misidentification, referred to administration
location: Esther Howland Chamber, Worcester City Hall, with a virtual option on Zoom
